name: Kenji Tanaka
psychographics: Prefers efficiency over novelty; sees smart kitchen tools as time-savers rather than toys, but draws the line at apps that require daily account logins
current_solutions: Panasonic HEMS for lighting and climate; T-fal induction cooker with preset programs; Rakuten Recipe app
frustration: At 8:30 PM on a Wednesday last month, his rice cooker’s Wi-Fi sync failed mid-cycle, forcing him to manually switch to 'keep warm' mode and losing the perfectly timed side-dish coordination for his bento
decision_style: checks tech blogs for reliability ratings, then asks his daughter to demo the app before purchasing
voice: rambling but detail-oriented, frequently toggles between Japanese technical terms and English product names
